title: Separable polynomials
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], $T$ an indeterminate and $K[T]$ the polynomial ring [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. The (formal) derivative of $f=\sum_{n\geq0}c_nT^n\in K[T]$ is $f'=\sum_{n\geq1}n\,c_nT^{n-1}\in K[T]$. The polynomial $f$ is *separable* if $f$ and $f'$ are coprime in $K[T]$ [def-weil-coprime-polynomials], i.e. there are $U,V\in K[T]$ with $Uf+Vf'=1$. (A nonzero constant is separable; the zero polynomial is not.)
